summary: Braze, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated October 19, 2026, under which Salesforce, Inc. will acquire Braze through its wholly owned subsidiary Banff Acquisition Sub Inc. in a reverse triangular merger, with Braze surviving as a wholly owned Salesforce subsidiary. Each outstanding Class A share converts into $47.50 per share in cash, without interest. The Braze board unanimously approved the transaction. In-the-money options and other equity awards are cashed out or converted per the merger formula. What to watch: stockholder vote, regulatory clearance, and any topping bids or dissenters.
